'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Peter Jacobson LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Jacobson]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5_sfnQDr1-o
* '''Username:''' Jeeps
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
